Code details
The full application uses Python, PyTorch, NumPy and the Hugging Face transformers library.

Code details
The complete computation runs with PyTorch ROCm on AMD MI250X GPUs on LUMI. No additional GPU library is required.

Code details
We plan to use GPUs. The software and GPU backend are not specified.

Code details
Our required custom CUDA extension runs only on NVIDIA GPUs. No AMD or ROCm implementation exists and no alternative is planned.

Code details
This exact application version was installed and ran successfully on LUMI-G last month.

Code details
This application has never been installed or run on LUMI.

Code details
The entire job uses only the preinstalled LUMI PyTorch environment. No custom packages or extra installations are needed.

Code details
Our custom code is not installed on LUMI. Installing it is the first work step.

Workplan
We will compare held-out accuracy for three model sizes and publish the resulting trained models and evaluation report.

Workplan
We will execute 100 independent jobs. Each runs for two hours on four GPUs. This requires 800 GPU-hours.

Workplan
The first week is reserved for installation, data transfer and preprocessing. Production runs start in week two.

Workplan
Every job must run sequentially because its input is the prior job result. The jobs need 100 days but the allocation lasts only 30 days.
